description: Request a server-issued one-time consent receipt for a scope (followup / usage_collection / alliance / publish_reviews). Returns a receipt id and a confirm_url (absolute, environment-correct; the receipt id travels as a URL fragment, never a query parameter): show the confirm_url to the user — they must confirm the scope on VCP's own confirmation page, in their own signed-in VibeCodePicks browser session, before the receipt can be used. The MCP client cannot confirm on their behalf. The receipt is single-use and expires in 15 minutes. Pass the receipt id as `receipt` to consent_update. Owner credential only.
name: consent_request_receipt
title: Request a consent receipt
